$comment: The AndroidX A2UI sample screens: material3-a2ui's integration-test demo, one screen per basic-catalog component, vendored at the commit in samples-catalog/import.json. Each render is the demo's compact layout — the Material catalog's drawing of the payload in a dotted card, above the vendored control panel that composed it. No kit reference: these are upstream's usage, not a design reproduction.
title: AndroidX A2UI samples
